qa_matrix.details: Single-line pipe delimited dates and exact 8% tax calculation
4-item multi-row invoice table with line multiplication and subtotal
Folded physical receipt with uneven margins, parentheses in items, and no due date
Low contrast mobile photo receipt with parentheses (1 Gal) and small fonts
International cross-border logistics invoice with omitted tax (null tax_amount)
Industrial wholesale bill with valid invoice date but omitted due date
Multi-page enterprise engineering statement with multi-item table
Micro-decimal item descriptions (0.01mm) and high-value equipment totals ($1250.00)

known_limitations.scope: Resumes, CVs, Corporate Memos, Essays, Corrupted/Empty files
known_limitations.behavior: Pre-flight heuristic & domain validator rejects non-invoices upfront with HTTP 422 NonInvoiceDocumentError.

known_limitations.scope: Mobile camera photos, low-contrast, crumpled or folded receipts
known_limitations.behavior: Visual amber fallback bounding boxes generated; flagged with degraded status for manual reviewer verification.

known_limitations.scope: Cross-border B2B transactions without local tax (doc_05)
known_limitations.behavior: Schema permits null tax_amount while arithmetic validator skips tax addition and flags amber review indicator.

known_limitations.scope: Invoices with 'Invoice Date: YYYY-MM-DD | Due Date: YYYY-MM-DD'
known_limitations.behavior: Label-anchored regex parsing disambiguates invoice_date and due_date on identical lines.
